name: Mistral AI
tagline: Open-weight and commercial LLMs via a chat-completions style REST API
description: Mistral AI provides a hosted REST API for large language models (chat, embeddings, OCR, and more). Developers call https://api.mistral.ai with an API key for inference against models such as Mistral Large, Ministral, and Codestral. Docs and pricing are published on docs.mistral.ai and mistral.ai.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header; create keys in the Mistral AI console (self-serve).

pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go per million tokens by model; exact rates on mistral.ai/pricing

use_cases: run chat completion with a Mistral model
extract text from documents with OCR API
